title: bot.ability.cognition.step.failed
description:
A step of the bot's cognition failed, so the turn it was taking failed.

The bot perceives this as a turn of its own: which step failed and why, and which turn failed for which stimulus. Only that turn failed; nothing was rebooted and every ability kept its state. A step that fails while the bot perceives a failed step is not handed back again. A decision layer or an intuition that fails is not handed back either: its turn goes on to the next stage, so the stage is reflex (a behavior) or reasoning in practice.

message.description: Human-readable failure message for the ability operation.
message.title: Message

stage.description: The stage of cognition that failed: reflex (a behavior running, or the decision model choosing on what no behavior handled), intuition (the fast words) or reasoning (the deliberate thinking).
stage.title: Stage

turn.description: The body's processing turn that failed, counted from 1; the original's turn_id [floppy field].

stimulus.description: Name of the stimulus the failed turn was taken up for, when it has one.
stimulus.title: Stimulus

examples.message: Cognition's reasoning step failed, so the turn failed: Provider request failed.
